attacksNotChargedWithDisclosure.whyNotCharged: The prompt's bar for this slot is that the role be last-heading custody only, and it is met literally and exactly: 'Last live heading at dispatch. The prompt's takeover list is G21, G23, G24 and G30, and all four are expressly disclaimed. Charging the absence of a belt-and-braces sentence that the prompt does not require, on an entry that already meets the stated bar, would be moving the goalpost. Recorded so a coordinator normalising the family can decide whether to require the disclaimer uniformly.

It does not occupy the identifier, does not open D-056 Class A, does not add a DR-G* row, does not edit file 08 or COORD, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. Frozen leftover-join.v3 and frozen occupancy v3 stay unmoved. Recording remains a later D-000 act, and consensus is the coordinator's to declare once Codex reports.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: Thirty-five attacks run, thirty-five refuted, none charged. The four integrity gates hold exactly: subject frozen at 9e1af4ba… mode 0444 and identical at review start and end, frozen leftover-join.v3 at 4ab44cae… unmoved, frozen occupancy v3 at 94a40de9… unmoved, and HEAD cbe471b matching both the top-level head and recordedInputs.HEAD. Thirty-five of thirty-five cited digests recompute against live bytes with zero mismatches, and the tracked tree is clean so every pin resolves against committed bytes rather than a dirty working copy. The decisive check on a successor is the structural diff against the dual-ACCEPT v3, and it comes back strictly additive: zero keys dropped, zero obligations dropped, zero obligation flags changed, zero disclaimers removed, and fourteen top-level keys — including the entire summary object — byte-identical. Because summary is byte-identical, leftoverDesign cannot have been flipped or stolen; it is the same single-element ['OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING'] carried since v1. Exactly one obligation's prose moved, OBL-G29-HARNESS-SPEC.reason, with its flag unchanged at false, and the edit is precisely the remasurement this successor exists to perform: it swaps the v2 specification citation for occupancy remasurement v3 at D-229 and attributes the pre-existing closure to leftover-join.v3 rather than claiming it. Four disclaimers were added, not removed. The three lineage traps all hold. Occupancy currency is correct in both directions — I enumerated all ten occurrences of 'current' and every one is either qualified by 'after this successor is recorded' or correctly assigns currency to occupancy v3; the subject simultaneously holds that v3 was current at draft time and will not be after recording, which is the hard part and it gets it right. predecessorV3 pins recording D-204, and I confirmed b6b77b8 really is 'D-204: record g29-leftover-join.v3'. The unfounded 'Landed in this lineage at v3' phrase is absent. basedOn.d253.role is custody only and leaks nothing — G28, leftover-join, leftoverDesign and OBL- are all absent from it — despite D-253 being a G28 recording. Three claims deserve special mention because they are checkable and were checked rather than assumed: naming v6 genuinely contains zero occurrences of G29, so the disclaimer is accurate; D-229's own COORD text independently says 'Naming parent is D-157', so parentReview agrees with the recording it cites; and the EE census returns exactly D-157's seven classes with EE-3a, EE-6b and G30's EE-7a/7b/7d all absent, which is positive evidence the grant was read. The historical required-now 26 survives only inside basedOn.predecessorV2.role, and I verified that figure is accurate — v2's head really is 5d5d778 and its doesNot really did say 26 — rather than left as decoration. Every '7.1' occurrence and both 'D9' occurrences are refusals, no fixture or observation bytes are invented, and no duplicate JSON keys hide a second value. One observation is disclosed and deliberately not charged: the last-heading entry omits an explicit G28 non-occupancy disclaimer that the sibling occupancy artifact chose to include, but the prompt's bar for that slot is last-heading custody only and the entry meets it literally with no G28 substance to disclaim. ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
